## isNotNull() function

Narrows a nullable value to its non-null type.

**Signature:**

```typescript
isNotNull: <T>(v: T | null) => v is T
```

**Returns:**

`true` when `v` is not `null`<!-- -->.

## Example


```ts
import { isNotNull } from "@morpho-org/morpho-ts";

const values = [1, null, 2].filter(isNotNull);
// values satisfies number[]
```
